member.name: T:Vecerdi.Extensions.DependencyInjection.SourceGenerator.MonoBehaviourSingletonFactoryAnalyzer
member.summary: VDI0008: a Singleton or Scoped factory registration whose lambda resolves a MonoSingleton<T>. The container caches whatever the factory returns, so the registration keeps handing out the instance (or a part of it) after Unity destroys it. A MonoBehaviour singleton is recognised by its base type alone; a plain MonoBehaviour registered with AddMonoBehaviourSingleton, or a resolve through an interface, is not flagged.

member.name: T:Vecerdi.Extensions.DependencyInjection.SourceGenerator.MonoBehaviourSingletonFactoryCodeFixProvider
member.summary: Rewrites a VDI0008 registration onto the AddMonoBehaviourSingleton family: a factory that returns the singleton becomes AddMonoBehaviourSingleton<TService, T>(), one that returns something built from it alone becomes the selector overload. A factory that resolves anything else gets no fix.
